title: rosa canina var. borreri
intro: Rosa canina var. borreri, commonly known as the Dog Rose or Borrer's Dog Rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant, a deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. borreri include its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can be used to soothe wounds, reduce pain and swelling, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. borreri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
